steps: Place the supplied observations in time order and separate symptoms from inferred causes.
Compare inlet readings with the applicable equipment guidance and inspect airflow dependencies on paper.
Assess the predictive drive alert alongside controller, RAID and backup state.
Choose read-only evidence that distinguishes competing hypotheses.
Write an escalation, service boundary and post-change verification plan without performing physical work.
labs.expected_result: A bounded triage report with evidence, competing hypotheses, approved next checks and recovery verification; the desk exercise does not establish the real cause of a hardware failure.
troubleshooting: A hot exhaust reading alone is not an inlet compliance measurement.
A predictive alert is neither a guaranteed failure date nor permission to remove a drive.
labs.cleanup: Retain only synthetic observations and remove unused draft files. No physical or electrical work is performed.
labs.evidence_prompt: Explain one hypothesis, the test that could disprove it and the decision requiring an authorised maintainer.

capstones.title: Restore and defend a segmented training network
capstones.scenario: A synthetic two-switch training network loses access to one VLAN after a controlled change. The same project must demonstrate the permitted web flow, blocked management flow and a defensible power/capacity estimate. Use only the isolated workbook topology or a clearly labelled tabletop prediction.
objectives: Apply an independently checked address and VLAN plan.
Distinguish physical, switching, routing, policy and application observations.
Recover one bounded fault with a measurable rollback trigger.
Communicate actual results and remaining failure dependencies.
steps: Choose simulator or tabletop mode and state which outputs will be observed versus predicted; save a known baseline.
Verify address boundaries, gateway membership and the assumed measured IT load before calculating energy/capacity.
Trace the allowed application flow and a deliberately denied flow with the relevant interfaces, routes and rule decisions.
Introduce a single missing-VLAN or route fault, preserve the initial incident hypothesis and gather discriminating evidence.
Peer-review the bounded restoration plan, execute only in the simulator, retest positive/negative requirements and complete a factual handover.
capstones.expected_result: The learner explains the path and failure using relevant evidence, restores the selected simulator baseline if executed, and reports capacity assumptions and remaining single points of failure. Tabletop predictions remain labelled predictions.
capstones.evidence_prompt: Collect the topology/address plan, calculations, change/rollback plan, allowed/denied/fault/recovery matrix, actual or explicitly predicted outputs, handover and reflection.
capstones.cleanup: Undo fault injections and restore the saved training topology. Stop any test services and retain only synthetic or approved sanitised evidence.

capstones.title: Evaluate an operations assistant without surrendering judgement
capstones.scenario: A fictional operations team needs a local inventory/health report and an AI-assisted explanation of an ambiguous alert. Build a bounded evidence trail that separates validated data, observed service state, model suggestions and authorised actions; choose either a supervised-placement preparation or optional-project planning context.
objectives: Validate synthetic inventory and observe local service outcomes.
Prove a limited restore and state what it cannot establish.
Evaluate binary predictions against a baseline and a declared error cost.
Verify an AI explanation, agent instructions and action boundaries.
Write a reviewable learning or project plan using actual evidence.
steps: Declare the practice scope, use synthetic inventory and choose the placement-preparation or optional-project planning route; confirm real institutional decisions separately.
Run the local validator and health examples with both successful and malformed/unavailable inputs, recording actual exit status and response meaning.
Perform the disposable one-file restore comparison and explain why it does not demonstrate full application recovery.
Compute the supplied classifier metrics and baseline, then inspect an AI-generated explanation against authoritative sources and reject untrusted instructions.
Run the synthetic Boolean/risk demo and show why a missing score or asserted authorisation cannot silently permit a protected action.
Present requirements, observations, sources, unresolved uncertainty and the next reviewable improvement, with a factual handover and personal reflection.
capstones.expected_result: The report reproduces the known fixture results, distinguishes model signals from verified facts and records bounded evidence without invented workplace outcomes or automatic qualification claims.
capstones.evidence_prompt: Save synthetic fixtures, actual reports/statuses, restore comparison, confusion matrix, claim/source table, policy self-checks, route-specific plan and an honest evaluation against stated acceptance criteria.
capstones.cleanup: Stop local services and remove only disposable files. Keep credentials and private placement records out of the notebook/export; retain permitted synthetic evidence.
